items.headline: Fire Weather Watch issued June 18 at 1:49PM AKDT until June 21 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
The National Weather Service in Fairbanks has issued a Fire
Weather Watch for lightning, which is in effect from Saturday
morning through Sunday evening.

* AFFECTED AREA...White Mountains, Tanana Valley, Chena River
Valley, Fortymile Country, and Eastern Delta Junction.

* TIMING...From Saturday morning through Sunday evening.

* THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE INDEX...Scattered.

* WINDS...Near thunderstorms, gusts could reach as high as 40
mph.

* HUMIDITY...As low as 30 percent.

* TEMPERATURES...High

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued June 18 at 1:47PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
On Friday through Sunday, a majority of the Central and Eastern
Interior will see multiple days of highs near/above 80 degrees
Fahrenheit. Take caution while participating in outdoor
activities planned for the solstice/holiday weekend. Stay hydrated
and limit strenuous outdoor activities in the afternoon when
temperatures are highest.

items.headline: Heat Advisory issued June 18 at 1:27PM AKDT until June 21 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Hot temperatures as high as 85 expected.

* WHERE...Yukon Flats.

* WHEN...From 1 PM Friday to 10 PM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these hot temperatures may
experience heat related illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Temperatures will reach their peak during
each afternoon from Friday through Sunday. Temperatures overnight
will provide some relief but remain warm, around 55 to 65.
items.instruction:
